LESSON: WRITING 11.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to correctly write names of objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: Exploration as the learner draws objects, colours them and responds to picture prompts.

Values:
Unity: as the learner collaborates with others in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills: Effective Communication as the learner names objects correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Writing names of objects is related to writing names of objects in other learning areas

Suggested Learning Resources

Chart, Class readers, Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, dictionary, Internet, Audio-visual recordings,

Posters, Pictures and Photographs, Extracts from newspapers, magazines.
